# Contributing

This repository hosts Junyan Yu's personal academic website. Corrections to content, documentation improvements, and website fixes are welcome.

1. Create a branch from `master` with a descriptive name.
2. Make your changes and check the affected content or functionality.
3. Open a pull request against this repository's `master` branch, describing the changes and any validation performed.

For local preview instructions, see [README.md](../README.md).
